title.en: Tale 7 — Dimna Speaks to the Ox

sentences.en: And afterwards Dimna went to Shatraba.
He said to him: I am your friend and I am warning you.
The lion wants to be rid of you.
Shatraba did not believe it at first.

sentences.ar: قال دمنة: لما تشوفه، رح يكون شكله متغير.
sentences.en: Dimna said: when you see him, his look will be changed.

sentences.ar: وهيك صار، لأن كل واحد فيهم صار خايف من التاني.
sentences.en: And so it was, because each of them had become afraid of the other.
